subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: What public `skills.load` contract should OpenClaw support for disabling built-in skill sources such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The source-level behavior is reproducible, but fixing it adds public config surface and changes built-in skill-source semantics, which the repository policy treats as maintainer-owned product/API direction.

options.title: Typed source-disable list
options.body: Add a small enum-backed `skills.load.disableSources` contract and apply it before discovery and watcher registration for built-in source ids.

options.title: Narrow personal toggle
options.body: Add only a personal `.agents/skills` toggle, which solves this issue with less generality but may create another one-off config knob later.

options.title: No new config
options.body: Keep current discovery and rely on prompt limits, per-skill disables, and agent allowlists, accepting that users with shared Claude Code skill directories still need manual cleanup.

recommendation.title: Typed source-disable list
recommendation.body: Add a small enum-backed `skills.load.disableSources` contract and apply it before discovery and watcher registration for built-in source ids.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and refactor history place this account closest to the current skills loader, watcher, and config surface.
